notes:
Titles and DOIs verified in acquired texts. Replication is the authors’ accepted manuscript, with different pagination from the supplied published-paper locator. Study 1 replication maps to §3.2 and Table 2; its sample reporting is internally inconsistent (p. 8 n = 213 self-relevant; Table 7 N = 211; p. 13 t(421)). Therefore analytic n is null and target_match is unknown pending resolution; d and p are a paired printed Table 2 result. No n inferred from degrees of freedom. In the original cached PDF text, the equals sign is extracted as 5; quotations preserve this extraction artifact, and statistic values reflect the printed equation.
Completion source review (n_r): The primary manuscript explicitly identifies 213 participants in the self-relevant past/future scenario used to replicate Caruso et al. (2008) Study 1, and states that reported analyses use the full sample. Section 3.2 identifies the self-relevant monetary comparison; supplementary Table B labels it hypothesis 1a. This is the target subset, rather than the generic combined Experiment 1 recruitment N=423. The inconsistent printed t(421) in section 3.2 is retained in checkpoint notes and was not used to derive N. Alternate excluded samples are separate analyses.
